we have identified a new class of models for leptogenesis, which are consistent with all current constraints, and in which the dark matter annihilation branching fraction to leptons is small, and the dark matter relic abundance is set by a thermal freezeout process.

the dark matter annihilation rate to leptons is not a reliable proxy for leptogenesis.
